summary: Iteration 3 — Visual & Interactive Upgrade Pass validation. Backend regression 4/4 pytest passing (root, insights list, insights slug, contact POST). Frontend: navbar renders the new raster wordmark /kbp-logo-gold.png (naturalWidth=954, loaded on all 10 pages). Duplicate hero wordmark on Home REMOVED — exactly one kbp-logo* img on Home and it lives in the navbar (not in hero section). Favicon assets all HTTP 200 (/favicon.ico, /favicon-32.png, /favicon-64.png). KO/EN toggle flips hero copy ('한국 브랜드의…' → 'Your Trusted Local Partner…') and persists to localStorage as kb-lang. All 10 nav links present and routable. Home: 4 pillars, 5 equal service cards, home-stat-value-0..3 render. Process: 5 interactive steps (STEP 01–05) — spec text said '6 steps' but design shipped 5 (consistent with iteration_2 acceptance). Team: 3 team-card-* with team-reveal-* hover panels (photos are KB monogram placeholders, names still '성함 예정'). Success: 5 filters + 4 case cards. Locations: 8 city cards, all skyline images loaded (naturalWidth=1600) including Dallas & New Jersey. Insights: 5 posts fetched from /api/insights; detail page renders. Contact form submits and shows KO toast '문의가 접수되었습니다'. FAQ accordion toggles state on click. Zero console/page errors during full site walk.

issues: Spec/review request mentions 6 process steps with Step 04 (Site Selection) emphasized; live page renders 5 steps (STEP 01 초기 상담, 02 법인 설립, 03 상업용 부동산, 04 프랜차이즈 개발 & FDD, 05 매장 오픈). Step 04 in live build is 'Franchise Development & FDD', not 'Site Selection'. Site Selection is covered by the 03 상업용 부동산 step. Not a regression from iteration_2 (which accepted 5), but a discrepancy vs current review-request wording — flag for E1 to confirm intent.

All 3 team-card names still read '성함 예정' (Name TBD) and cards use a large 'KB' monogram in place of member photos. Hover-reveals do render (team-reveal-0..2 present). Content placeholders, not a code bug — intentional per current CMS state.

AnimatedCounter is fed placeholder bracketed strings ('[수십]', '[X]', '[X]', '[8]') so there is no numeric counting animation to speak of — component correctly renders the raw text. Intentional per iteration_2 spec.

action_items: Confirm intended Process step count (5 vs 6) and whether Step 04 should be renamed / re-emphasized to 'Site Selection' per review-request wording.
Replace Team placeholder names ('성함 예정') and KB monogram covers with real member data + photos when available.
critical_code_review_comments: Logo.jsx now a thin wrapper — clean. Consider adding width/height attributes to prevent CLS on slow networks.
Home.jsx hero wordmark correctly removed; comment on line 158 documents the intent — good.

AnimatedCounter receiving non-numeric bracketed placeholders means the 'counter animation' feature is inert on Home stats. If those placeholders survive to production, consider hiding the counter animation or wrapping in a guard so the component isn't misleadingly named.
Team page still has no real photos — SEO/OG image quality suffers. Not a code issue but flag for content.
